response.sql: WITH e AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_hum FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), g AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS all_avg FROM e), ab AS (SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_hum FROM e, g WHERE e.avg_hum > g.all_avg), gm AS (SELECT AVG(avg_hum) AS grp_avg FROM ab) SELECT ab.equipref AS equipment_reference, ab.avg_hum AS average_humidity, ab.avg_hum - g.all_avg AS exceeds_all_equipment_avg, ab.avg_hum - gm.grp_avg AS diff_from_group_mean FROM ab, g, gm WHERE g.all_avg IS NOT NULL AND gm.grp_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (ab.avg_hum - gm.grp_avg) IS NULL, (ab.avg_hum - gm.grp_avg) DESC LIMIT 10
